title: Down the Rivers
summary: The Rio Negro in the floods of 2778. The swarm comes down the rivers; Valadares brings Nazaré's people out and holds the Barra on its bluff.

sides.name: The Barra
sides.about: Valadares and the Barra do Rio Negro: the column, the garrison on the bluff, two guns, the church; Nazaré's people upriver.

sides.name: The Swarm
sides.about: The Brood coming down the rivers in the floods: forward Mothers rooting on the far bank, and what they lay.

objectives.text: The church on the bluff must stand.
The Barra's Town Hall must stand.

NAZARÉ: take the column north up the bank trail to the village. Walk a man up to each group of its people (the chapel, the houses, the fields): they then go to Benedito's canoes on the beach by themselves. {out_n} of {vill_n} away.
objectives.phone: Nazaré: a man to each group; they go to the canoes. {out_n} of {vill_n} away.

objectives.text: The forward Mother across the river roots in {clock:nazare}: then the creatures come over the rapids in numbers.

THE BLUFF: bring the column home down the bank trail. The creatures come over the shallows in waves: hold the lower town by the river and the three gates of the bluff. Train Musketeers at the Barracks; your Labourers mend the palisade.
objectives.phone: The bluff: hold the lower town and the three gates. Wave {wave_n} of 5.

objectives.text: THE FORWARD MOTHERS: two more walk down the far bank to root on it; every one rooted puts more creatures in every wave. Cross a shallows with the Dragoons and kill one while she walks ({fwd_killed} killed, {fwd_rooted} rooted).
objectives.phone: Kill a forward Mother before she roots: {fwd_killed} killed, {fwd_rooted} rooted.

objectives.text: THE GREAT WAVE: it comes over the Barra shallows in the dark. Break it, or hold the bluff until first light.
Hold the church and the Town Hall until the floods fall: {clock:floods}.
At least one of your forward Mothers must live.
NAZARÉ: the village across the rapids is emptying into Benedito's canoes. Cross the rapids with your Raptors and catch its people before they are away.
THE FAR BANK: walk your second Mother down the far bank and ROOT her in the clearing opposite the Barra (south-west of it, across the Barra shallows). Her swamp then reaches the river.
BREAK THE BARRA: kill the two guns on the bluff's river edge and break the church ({guns_left} guns left). Brutes break palisades; GROW a Mother to stage 3 for them.
objectives.phone: Kill the two guns ({guns_left} left) and break the church.

objectives.text: The floods fall in {clock:floods}: then the far bank dries and the Barra holds.

options.label: BURN IT
options.about: Rome's order. The whole great wave comes over the Barra shallows tonight: the Barra holds by arms.

options.label: USE IT ONCE
options.about: Benedito sets the old lure on the far point: half the great wave turns into the flooded forest. Then the book burns.

k_open1.text: Three years after the island, the floods came higher than the last. The swarm came down with them.

k_open2.text: Valadares held the Barra that season. This is his report, as he wrote it.

k_linnea.text: He told me later he had seen the first of them on the plateau, years before. He knew them at once.

v_open1.text: The Rio Negro, the floods of 2778. Every town above the Barra was empty by Lent.

v_open2.text: Nazaré was the last. Its people had nowhere to go but our canoes.

k_open_s.text: Valadares wrote this down as it happened. Here is how it would have gone if the bluff had fallen.

n_open_s.text: The floods. Forward Mothers root on the far bank, and the ground creeps out from them toward the river.

v_1.text: Column, with me. Up the bank trail to Nazaré, and quickly. Benedito has the canoes at the beach.

n_lesson.text: Nazaré is north, up the bank trail. Its people are in three groups: by the chapel, in the houses, in the fields. Walk any of your men up to a group and it goes to the canoes by itself.

n_base.text: The Barra is yours as well: Labourers on the Farms, Musketeers from the Barracks. The waves will come here when Nazaré is out.

v_map.text: I drew their road down from the plateau myself. They will cross where the river is shallow: the rapids, the middle, the Barra.

v_sealed.text: My map of the plateau is under seal in Rome. I will learn their road the hard way, as they come.

b_party_few.text: Senhor, I am the last of the plateau's party still on the river. Let us not lose anyone else.

g_chapel.text: The people by the chapel take up their bundles and go down to the beach.

g_houses.text: The families in the houses come out and go down to the beach.

g_fields.text: The people in the manioc fields leave their baskets and run for the beach.

b_first.text: The first are in the canoes, Senhor. I can take them all, if they get here.

n_raid.text: Creatures come over the rapids from the far bank, after the people. Keep your men between them and the villagers.

n_rooted.text: Across the river the forward Mother roots. Her ground creeps toward the water, and more come over the rapids.

b_wait.text: I cannot wait much longer, Senhor! Whoever is not on the beach stays.

b_away.text: We are away! Down to the Barra, Senhor. Do not stay up here.

n_left.text: Some of Nazaré's people did not reach the beach. They went into the forest, and nobody saw them again.

v_2.text: Back to the Barra, all of you. Down the trail. They will be at the shallows before us.

s_2.text: Senhor Valadares! Creatures on the far bank, opposite the lower town. The guns are loaded.

n_waves.text: They come in waves, over the Barra shallows into the lower town and over the middle shallows down the bank trail. The guns on the bluff reach the shallows.

n_fwd.text: A forward Mother walks down the far bank to root. Rooted, her ground creeps, and every wave grows by what she lays. Cross a shallows with the Dragoons and kill her on the way.

n_fwd2.text: Another forward Mother sets off down the far bank, toward the clearing opposite the Barra.

n_fwd_root.text: A forward Mother has rooted on the far bank. More will come in every wave now.

n_fwd_dead.text: A forward Mother is dead before she could root. The waves stay smaller.

v_fwd_dead.text: Good. Back over the water before the next wave.

n_wave.text: A wave is coming over the shallows.

s_quarter.text: A house in the lower town is burning, Senhor!

v_mend.text: Labourers to the palisade. Mend what they break.

n_dusk.text: Dusk. On the far bank they are gathering, more than in any wave before.

b_book.text: Senhor. Your men brought this from the fazenda's ruins. The Doctor's lure book.

b_book_taken.text: Senhor. The Doctor left this at the Barra's warehouse for his passage downriver. His lure book.

b_lure.text: I know the old lure. A post on the far point, a jar on it, and they turn off their road into the flooded forest.

v_rome.text: Rome ordered every one of these books burned.

v_burn.text: No man should call them. Not even once. Into the fire with it.

n_burn.text: The book burns. The whole wave will come over the Barra shallows: hold the lower town and the west gate.

v_use.text: Once, for the town. Then it goes in the fire. Benedito, take two men and the canoe.

n_use.text: Benedito sets the lure post on the far point. Part of the wave will turn off its road into the flooded forest.

v_vs_burn.text: Rome ordered the books burned. This one too. We hold the Barra with what we have.

n_night.text: Night. The great wave comes down to the far bank.

n_go.text: The great wave goes into the water at the Barra shallows.

n_lured.text: Half the wave turns toward the far point, past it, into the flooded forest.

n_drowned.text: The water closes over their road. They do not come out of the flooded forest tonight.

s_great.text: Here they come! Canister, at the shallows!

n_broken.text: The great wave is broken. What is left of it goes back into the dark.

n_dawn.text: First light. The far bank is quiet; the swarm has gone back into the flooded forest.

v_won.text: The Barra stands. Ring the bell, sergeant. Then count the houses.

v_hurt.text: I am hit. Keep the line, keep the line.

n_hall_lost.text: The bluff is broken. The Barra is lost.

n_s1.text: Your forward Mother is rooted across the rapids from Nazaré, your Sires by her. Lay eggs on her card; the grubs make Rootmaws on her swamp for food.

n_s2.text: Your second Mother waits on the far bank's middle. Walk her south and root her opposite the Barra.

n_s_canoes.text: Nazaré's people reach the canoes and are gone down the river.

n_s_root.text: A Mother roots opposite the Barra. Her swamp reaches the water.

n_s_reinf.text: Canoes come up from downriver: more men for the Barra.

n_s_gun.text: A gun on the bluff is silent.

n_s_won.text: The guns are silent and the church is down. The bluff is the swarm's.

n_s_lost.text: The floods fall. The far bank dries, and the Barra still stands.

v_end1.text: We held the bluff. Nazaré's people slept in the church, the canoes on the bank below.

v_end_held.text: The lower town stood. Every roof.

v_end_burned.text: The lower town burned. We held only what stood on the bluff.

v_end_burnt_book.text: I burned the book with my own hand, as Rome ordered.

v_end_used_book.text: I used the book once. Then I burned it. I have confessed it.

k_end1.text: He held the river for me that year. He did it with muskets, and once, with a dead man's book.

k_end1b.text: He held the river for me that year. With muskets, and without the book. That was harder.

k_end2.text: The swarm did not go back up the rivers. It waited in the flooded forest for the next floods.

k_end_s.text: That is not how it went. Valadares held the bluff. But I have kept this page.

n_end_s.text: The church burned on the bluff. The swarm's ground crept over the Barra by the dry season.

new_nb_clutch_raptor.text: NEW: BIGGER CLUTCH. Research it on the Tyrant Sire's card: Raptors hatch three to an egg instead of two (the egg costs more, each Raptor the same). More teeth at the shallows.

new_nb_pack_hunt.text: NEW: PACK HUNT. Research it on the Tyrant Sire's card: Raptors, Tyrant Challengers and the Sire run faster; a Raptor then outruns a horse. Catch the people before the canoes.

new_nb_quick_roots.text: NEW: QUICK ROOTS. Research it on a Mother's card: every creature roots and uproots in half the time. A forward Mother walks down the bank and is rooted again before the guns find her.

rome.caption: Rome, the present. The King with the mapmaker's report.

waters.caption: The Barra do Rio Negro, where the black river meets the brown, the floods of 2778.

book.caption: The lure book, by the fire.

text: The Rio Negro, the floods of 2778. You are Valadares and the Barra do Rio Negro: a column at the north gate, the garrison on the bluff, two guns and the town.
First take the column up the bank trail to Nazaré and send its people to Benedito's canoes. Then come home: the swarm crosses the shallows in waves.
At dusk you will decide what to do with Lindqvist's lure book. The church and the Town Hall must stand.
The Rio Negro, the floods of 2778. You are the swarm: two forward Mothers on the far bank, their Sires, and what they lay.
Catch Nazaré's people before the canoes take them, root a Mother opposite the Barra, and break the Barra: its two guns and its church, before the floods fall.

barra.title: The Barra Holds
barra.text: Of Nazaré's {vill_n} people, {out_n} came down the river. {q_left} of the lower town's {q_n} houses stand.

text_if.text: The lure book was used once, then burned.
The lure book was burned, as Rome ordered.

swarm.title: The Bluff Falls
swarm.text: The guns are silent and the church is down. Of Nazaré's {vill_n} people, {out_n} got away.
